extraction.document_summary: AIA Secure Flexi Term is a Singapore life protection plan (no savings/investment feature) that provides death, terminal illness, and terminal cancer coverage. It supports two main base coverage options: a Renewable term option where you choose 5, 10, 20, or 30 years of coverage with guaranteed renewal up to age 101 regardless of health condition, and a Level term option where you choose coverage up to age 65 or 75 with premiums that stay the same throughout the coverage term. Premiums are guaranteed based on the age when you first sign up and stay the same throughout the policy period. Coverage ends when the full 100% coverage amount is paid upon death/terminal illness/terminal cancer. The brochure also notes exclusions such as pre-existing conditions and that waiting period applies before benefits are payable.
quality_notes: Product is clearly identified as AIA Secure Flexi Term with two base coverage option types and explicit rider names.
The document contains general statements about exclusions and waiting periods, but does not provide detailed definitions of triggers (other than Early Critical Cover mechanics).
Entry age, limits (annual/lifetime), free-look period, grace period, and surrender/cash value mechanics are largely not specified beyond high-level notes.

policies.quick_summary: A term life protection plan with terminal illness and terminal cancer coverage. Includes two base option types (renewable term up to age 101; level term up to age 65 or 75) and provides a conversion privilege before age 70 without further medical underwriting (subject to conversion conditions). Premiums are guaranteed based on age at first sign-up and stay the same throughout the policy period. Pre-existing conditions and waiting periods affect benefit payment eligibility; the plan has no cash value if it ends or terminates prematurely (as stated). Based on AIA brochure dated 1 April 2021 information.

source_evidence.quote: AIA Secure Flexi Term is designed to do just that. It offers high coverage at affordable premiums along with a wide range of protection options to suit your needs.
Guaranteed renewal up to age 101 regardless of health condition
Premiums stay the same throughout the coverage term
The plan can be converted to a whole life, endowment, or investment-linked plan before age 70 with no further medical underwriting required.
As this product has no savings or investment feature, there is no cash value if the policy ends or if the policy is terminated prematurely.

review_notes: Converted/vesting options to endowment, investment-linked, or whole life are stated as a conversion privilege, but are not extracted as separate products.
